guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0046 to 0.1538 (+3212%, z=+642) and latency-50 rose +2105%, while its CPU, memory and socket metrics fell and no other service shows a comparable shift. Emailservice is a callee of checkoutservice, and the worst traces show error spans in checkoutservice and frontend, which fits a delay propagating upstream. The digest has no logs and the trace paths do not list emailservice, so confidence is medium.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate network delay or latency injection on emailservice (check its network path, sidecar and egress config). Remove any injected delay or restart the emailservice pod if the delay persists. Consider a timeout and circuit breaker on checkoutservice calls to emailservice.
